def longest_regular_bracket_sequence(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    count = 0
    stack = []
    lengths = [0] * n
    
    for i, char in enumerate(s):
        if char == '(':
            stack.append(i)
        else:
            if stack:
                j = stack.pop()
                lengths[i] = lengths[j - 1] + (i - j + 1)
                if lengths[i] > max_length:
                    max_length = lengths[i]
                    count = 1
                elif lengths[i] == max_length:
                    count += 1
    
    return max_length, count
